<subject>Re: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.</subject>
<body>
You need to contact whoever it is you are speaking to at Newmont Mining Corp. and tell them we have never received a request to assign the financial deals, and if they would like to send us one we will take a look at it.

Theodore Gates
6/13/2024 10:40 AM

To: Bonnie Gardner
cc:
Subject: Re: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.

Hi Bonnie,
I didn't know if I forwarded this to you or not, but they are indeed marking up the financial deals Would you like for me to forward them to you?

Thanks
Theodore
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Theodore Gates
Sent: Thursday, June 13, 2024 10:38 AM
To: Bonnie Gardner
Subject: Re: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.


From: Marcus Hunt
Sent: Friday, May 31, 2024 08:04 AM
To: Theodore Gates
Cc:
Subject: Re: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.

Theodore,

Make sure Bonnie knows that they are marking up the Houston office. The
Physical signoff does us no good.

Joseph


Theodore Gates
Sent: Thursday, May 30, 2024 06:52 PM
To: Marcus Hunt
Cc:
Subject: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.

FYI...I had already been talking to Bonnie about this.
Since credit was working on it, I didn't provide a reply to you yet.

Theodore
-----Original Message-----
From: Bonnie Gardner
Sent: Thursday, May 30, 2024 06:23 PM
To: Zachary Preston; Lauren Cunningham
Cc: Heidi Robinson; Theodore Gates
Subject: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.

This is a consent to the physical business, not financial. Lauren Cunningham will sign off on this as soon as she gets Investment Committee approval, which it appears she has not yet.

From: Heidi Robinson

Cc:
Subject: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.

BONNIE CAN YOU HANDLE THIS? THANKS!

Heidi Robinson
Cedar Point Capital Partners
1400 Cedar Street, Room 7A42
Charlotte, NC 28202
Phone: (216) 799-7516
Fax: (216) 657-8143
-----Original Message-----
From: Heidi Robinson
Sent: Thursday, May 30, 2024 05:54 PM
To: Marcus Hunt
Cc:
Subject: [Investment Opportunity] Newmont Mining Corp.

Heidi,

Can you let me know if we have a recent Assignment Agreement for the above referenced Newmont Mining Corp.? We are receiving documents with the 'Mining Operations' crossed out of their name. Leaving the name as Newmont Capital. These are debt deals, therefore we cannot change this to match them unless we have done some Assignment Agreement that we haven't seen. Let me know if you know anything.

Thanks,
Joseph
